evidence.quote: the recent decline in availability of credit to small businesses concerns me.
While all small businesses are vulnerable to economic downturns, this recession has hit minority small businesses particularly hard.
I do not believe it is appropriate or even possible for regulators to urge banks to make loans that are outside their risk tolerance or that would be unsafe or unsound.
The more we do now, the better prepared our small businesses and lending institutions will be when economic growth and consumer demand pick up.

parsed.rationale: The speech focuses on small business credit access, supervisory guidance, and data collection, not monetary policy. It notes weak credit conditions and a hard recession, giving a mild dovish tilt on activity, but takes no stance on policy.
